name: Loop Watch
description: The Sigmally tuning loop at a glance: whether it is running, paused or overdue, the current round and what it did, bots in the game over the last 12 hours, alerts fired, and Pause / Run a round now. Watches the bots itself and alerts your phone when two or fewer are in the game.
agent: The live tuning loop's panel. After every loop round call loop_round with a one-line summary and when the next round is due. Check loop_status at the start of each round: if it says paused, only read the numbers - do not change or deploy the bot.
